description: This file serves as the entry point for a React.js web application. It imports necessary modules, including React, ReactDOM, stylesheet, and the main App component. It creates a React root and renders the App component within a StrictMode wrapper into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to control a React component tree for rendering into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
